movers.text: QB Brock Purdy (low ankle sprain, hurt Week 11 vs. Minnesota) did not practice Wednesday; Kyle Shanahan called him day to day with a 'possibility' he misses Seattle. Mac Jones would start.
Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. Denver: the Steelers benched Aaron Rodgers Tuesday and waived him Wednesday after his McAfee Show interview, per ESPN.
QB Justin Herbert (concussion protocol since the Week 11 loss to the Jets) did not practice Wednesday; Jim Harbaugh said DJ Uiagalelei is next up if he can't clear it.
QB Sam Darnold (quad/ribs), out since Week 8, practiced fully Wednesday and is on track to start Sunday at San Francisco, per Mike Macdonald. Drew Lock (elbow) was limited.
QB Carson Beck (back spasms) did not practice Wednesday after missing the loss at Kansas City; Josh Johnson is preparing to start vs. Washington. Gardner Minshew is on IR.

LAC.text: QB Justin Herbert (concussion protocol since the Week 11 loss to the Jets) did not practice Wednesday; Jim Harbaugh said DJ Uiagalelei is next up if he can't clear it.
LB Daiyan Henley (knee) and CB Tarheeb Still missed Week 11; Harbaugh said both are day to day in treatment this week.

SEA.text: QB Sam Darnold (quad/ribs), out since Week 8, practiced fully Wednesday and is on track to start Sunday at San Francisco, per Mike Macdonald. Drew Lock (elbow) was limited.
OL: RT Abraham Lucas (ankle) and G Quenton Nelson (knee) are ruled out for Sunday at San Francisco, Mike Macdonald said.

ARI.text: QB Carson Beck (back spasms) did not practice Wednesday after missing the loss at Kansas City; Josh Johnson is preparing to start vs. Washington. Gardner Minshew is on IR.
Secondary: DBs Will Johnson and Andrew Wingard are on IR. The Cardinals also fired DC Nick Rallis on Monday; Teryl Austin is interim DC.

NE.text: Mike Vrabel said Tommy DeVito stays QB1 while Drake Maye (fractured right fibula, Week 10) is out; Maye remains on the 53-man roster.
G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) was designated to return from IR on Monday.
WR A.J. Brown (hamstring) wasn't on the field for Monday's practice session and is listed doubtful by ESPN.

IND.text: The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Anthony Richardson Sr. makes his first start of the season vs. the Giants.
OT Jalen Travis and CB Charvarius Ward did not practice Wednesday; OT Bernhard Raimann and CB Sauce Gardner, who also missed Week 11, practiced fully.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring), out Weeks 9-11, is questionable; Kevin O'Connell has said Kirk Cousins stays the starter. WR Jordan Addison (thumb) is not expected to play.
LT Christian Darrisaw hurt his right shoulder in the Week 11 loss to San Francisco; the injury is not considered serious, per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler. His status for Atlanta is not set.

SF.text: QB Brock Purdy (low ankle sprain, hurt Week 11 vs. Minnesota) did not practice Wednesday; Kyle Shanahan called him day to day with a 'possibility' he misses Seattle. Mac Jones would start.
RT Colton McKivitz (fractured, dislocated ankle) was placed on injured reserve; CB Nate Hobbs (hamstring) was activated off IR.

PHI.text: Joe Milton starts again; he started Weeks 9 and 11 after Tanner McKee (now limited, ribs) started Weeks 7-8. Jalen Hurts is on IR.
CB Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) practiced fully and has no game status; edge Arnold Ebiketie (oblique) and CB Jonathan Jones (ankle) are ruled out at Dallas.

DET.text: Secondary: CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder) is ruled out for Thanksgiving vs. Chicago and S Chuck Clark (hamstring) is questionable; CB D.J. Reed practiced fully.
Front seven: DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL) and LB Jack Campbell are on IR, DT Skyler Gill-Howard went on IR Wednesday, and edge DJ Wonnum (back) is questionable.

CHI.text: Secondary: CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) and S Elijah Hicks (concussion) are ruled out for Thanksgiving at Detroit; CB Tyrique Stevenson (groin) is questionable.

KC.text: RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is ruled out at Buffalo, his third straight missed game, and OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) is out too.
G Trey Smith (concussion), who missed Week 11, practiced fully all week and has no game status for Buffalo.

BUF.text: CB Christian Benford (groin), TE Dalton Kincaid, G O'Cyrus Torrence, DL T.J. Sanders and LB Dorian Williams are all questionable for Kansas City after limited practices.

DAL.text: TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle), G Tyler Booker (ankle), WR Jonathan Mingo and S P.J. Locke (concussion) are all ruled out for Thanksgiving vs. Philadelphia.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) was activated off IR after a full practice Wednesday and is questionable vs. Philadelphia.

NO.text: OL: OTs Asim Richards and Taliese Fuaga, C Erik McCoy and G David Edwards were limited Wednesday after the three starters sat the last two games.
TE Juwan Johnson (hamstring), hurt in the 21-13 loss at Chicago, did not practice Wednesday.

BAL.text: Jacoby Brissett has started Weeks 10-11; Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) has a possible Week 16 return.
RB Derrick Henry was put back in the concussion protocol Wednesday after brief symptoms late in the Carolina game and was limited; Jesse Minter said the Ravens expect him to play.
CB Marlon Humphrey was a healthy scratch at Carolina; the Ravens are noncommittal on him for Houston. DT Nnamdi Madubuike is questionable.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR, surgery not foreseen per Jeff Hafley; Kyle McCord started Weeks 10-11 and goes again vs. the Jets.

LV.text: Rookie Fernando Mendoza makes his third start since Kirk Cousins was traded to Minnesota; he was sacked five times in the Week 11 loss at Denver.
TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad), who missed Week 11 at Denver, was limited in Wednesday's practice.

PIT.text: Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. Denver: the Steelers benched Aaron Rodgers Tuesday and waived him Wednesday after his McAfee Show interview, per ESPN.
LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) is expected to miss Friday vs. Denver, per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler; DT Cameron Heyward did not practice Wednesday and LB Nick Herbig (hip) was limited.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR) was a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough and is expected back vs. Denver.

HOU.text: LB Azeez Al-Shaair is on IR after groin surgery and DE Chris Braswell (knee, Nov. 19) is out for the season; DE Danielle Hunter is questionable.

JAX.text: OL: OT Walker Little (knee) and C Robert Hainsey were limited Wednesday and RT Anton Harrison is on IR; G Patrick Mekari was designated to return. RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice.

NYG.text: CB Greg Newsome II (high ankle sprain) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday after John Harbaugh said he will miss multiple weeks.
Edge Abdul Carter (ankle/calf) did not practice Wednesday; TE Isaiah Likely (groin) was limited.

TEN.text: OL: Peter Skoronski, Jackson Slater and Fernando Carmona are all on IR; RB Tyjae Spears (knee) also went on IR.

TB.text: Secondary: CB Benjamin Morrison (hamstring) and CB Jacob Parrish (back) had MRIs Monday; S Antoine Winfield Jr. is questionable.

DEN.text: RB J.K. Dobbins is suspended for Friday at Pittsburgh; DE Sai'vion Jones (hamstring) and S Taylor Rapp (quad) will not travel. S Brandon Jones practiced fully.
